headline: Bitcoin Drops Below $59,000 as Investors Shift to Cash
summary: Bitcoin fell below $59,000, moving closer to its summer low of $57,700 as investors retreated into cash holdings. Market strategists warned that potential Federal Reserve actions could create additional pressure.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization and serves as a broad indicator for digital asset markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin price plunged below $59,000 amid a general market flight to cash.
